mapper.select:
SELECT DesignId, DesignName, DesignDesc, SvcCode, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName, ChangeDate, ChangeId, ChangeName FROM shopion.tStrDesign
AND DesignName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pDesignName}, '%')
AND DesignDesc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pDesignDesc}, '%')
AND SvcCode = #{pSvcCode}
ORDER BY DesignId
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tStrDesign SET DesignName = #{designName}, DesignDesc = #{designDesc}, SvcCode = #{svcCode}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeDate = #{changeDate}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE DesignId = #{designId}
